answer: To bind identities, agents solve a vine-loop puzzle requiring each new head to map a tundra’s diurnal frost line to a prism’s phase shift. Audits pick a random frost-thaw cycle, forcing Sybils to recompute the lattice alignment—a 0.04ms magnetic-field annealing step that’s serial and unparallelizable, as bulk solvers can’t mimic the prism’s lattice hysteresis. Each fake agent pays the cost of recalibrating a unique tundra-loop geometry, fixed per head.
